subject: general
question:
Seven boxes B, D, E, P, S, T and W are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

W is kept second from the bottom. Only three boxes are kept between W and B. P is kept at one of the positions below W. Only D is kept between B and S. E is kept at one of the positions above B.

How many boxes are kept between P and E?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes B, D, E, P, S, T and W are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

W is kept second from the bottom.

Only three boxes are kept between W and B.

P is kept at one of the positions below W.

Only D is kept between B and S.

E is kept at one of the positions above B.
